description: Test delayed old-leader assignment consumption after a replacement value is decided by a new quorum. The principal invocation is observed from its real TaggedProposal through Assigned, replacement decision at origin, and future completion plus live read. This is a safety implication, not a completion deadline test.

harness.description: Three public actors and a controlled in-process caller transport; generated messages are routed or retained unchanged. Bounded loops assert prerequisite reachability only.
semantic_changes: Executor adapter delegates spawn/sleep to Tokio without modifying actor semantics.
Transport withholds old leader links and later releases the original 1->3 stream; no protocol substitutions.

legality.derivation: Core build validates nodes 1,2,3 and default majority. Each actor starts with empty MemoryStorage. A standard Tokio-backed AsyncRuntime implements only spawn/sleep because the selected crate need not enable optional TokioRuntime. All target code is unmodified. Public try_become_leader elects node 1 and actual messages establish Accept on all nodes. The origin submits exactly one append_notify(101); the real TaggedProposal UUID and old leader Assigned are observed. Old leader outbound traffic is retained before delivery, so only node 1 accepts 101. Nodes 2 and 3 then run a real higher-ballot prepare/sync, admit 202 and decide it on their quorum. The 1->3 stream is released in FIFO order afterward. Runtime ticks continue every millisecond but core election/retry timeouts are 100000 ticks, avoiding unrelated automatic takeovers during the bounded history. Events are drained during message pumping; the small remaining suffix cannot fill the 1024-event channel. Handles are dropped and the test runtime ends after completion. No target manifests, locks, private fields or messages are edited.
legality.applicability: One valid configuration, distinct values, batch size one, no crash/compaction or state substitution; manually requested elections and per-link FIFO delayed messages.
alternatives: The pending request may conservatively report Superseded or Timeout, which is permitted.

grounding.derivation: Applies c-notify-identity to one real actor invocation. UUID is generated by the target and checked against its Assigned response. Numeric assignment is one-based accepted length; read_decided_suffix(index-1) observes the actual entry after completion. Success implies identity; Superseded/Timeout does not require success.

observable_properties.description: Successful completion must identify the original input value in the live decided log at the returned index; errors are permitted.

uncertainties: A compilation/setup failure is not a property outcome.
No claim of core consensus disagreement or arbitrary-schedule progress.
